newsitem.title: USA: Nevada economy strong, but risks remain - S&P.
newsitem.headline: Nevada economy strong, but risks remain - S&P.

text.p: Nevada's economy has benefited in recent years from the booming gaming and recreation industries, but the growth could create problems over time, Standard & Poor's Corp said Monday.

Given the state's strong growth trends, debt issuance and infrastructure improvements will be key credit issues for municipalities in Nevada, the rating agency said in its CreditWeek Municipal newsletter.
"Due to the state's strong economy, California's apparent economic recovery, and further rapid urbanization in local areas, growth management will be a big challenge for Nevada's cities," S&P said.
S&P said the strength of the state's gaming and tourism industries have translated into a string of rating upgrades for local governments.

The concentrated nature of the economy could, however, present a risk over time, S&P said. If growth slows suddenly, municipalities could face shrinking budgets and high debt levels, the rating agency said.
